result.summary: Found 1 major content/localization defect: a section heading is rendering as a raw localization key instead of readable text. Excluded expected carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff per instructions.

issues.description: The section title displays the raw string "home_feed.popular_title" rather than a localized heading such as "Popular near you".
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization mapping for home_feed.popular_title or add a fallback so users never see internal keys.
